description: This file is a shell script utilizing Git commands to perform and verify various complex diff operations, including setup of test history, execution of combined diff commands, and validation of output against expectations.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with a specified message or content.

methods.name: git checkout
methods.description: Switches branches or restores working tree files.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Merges one or more development histories into the current branch.

methods.name: git rev-parse
methods.description: Provides SHA-1 or other revision identifiers.

methods.name: git log
methods.description: Shows commit logs with various formatting options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with setup and validation commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs and reports differences.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
